# PDF.js vendor files

This folder contains the minimal prebuilt Mozilla PDF.js runtime used by the custom lesson viewer.

- Version: pdfjs-dist 4.10.38
- Source: https://unpkg.com/pdfjs-dist@4.10.38/build/
- Vendored files:
  - `pdf.mjs`
  - `pdf.worker.mjs`

The stock PDF.js viewer, examples, source maps, and development files are intentionally not included.
